title: Design note: script subset, EVA placement, per-call gate and limits
goal: The owner can decide on script plans from one page
acceptance: docs/design/script-plans.md names the allowed subset, where scripts run, how each call is gated, budgets and failure modes
A fresh-context design review of the note is recorded
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: Any write or external effect from a script goes to the owner as a decision
A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-20 from the Agentica review. Not a measurement.
